user_reported_bug: Live loop_678eea28436c4e nearly wiped the entire README because the AI executor emitted the literal placeholder text `[Rest of existing README content remains unchanged...]` as file content (>90% file shrink). The `.md → linter: skip` verify branch reported ok:true, and the ship gate opened with the truncated content — only `awaiting_confirmation_timeout` prevented the commit. Separately, `scan_results = NameError("name '_scan_text' is not defined")` — scan phase hard-crashed but the loop treated it as non-fatal and proceeded to ship. On reload, loops in `state=paused_for_user + phase=ship + ship_pending` disappeared from the UI (chat, ship panel, commit message all wiped). Top LoopStepper showed EXECUTE-orange while ChatPanel showed 5/5 ready-to-ship (two separate state sources). Also `console.clear()` fired every ~30s wiping DevTools. Also plan generation took 21.6s for a one-line README edit with no visibility into what took the time.
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Focused verification reran Iter 318-322 tests (46 passed), Iter 312 async tests (4 passed), preview /loop/start API smoke (passed), synthetic pre-ship guard (passed), scan fail-closed runtime (passed), and ship hydration API (passed). However, a targeted runtime probe found _do_verify can still finish with report.ok=true for a .md file containing `[Rest of existing README content remains unchanged...]` after a no-op/escalated self-heal, because the integrity guard is not re-run after subset reverify; verdict is not_fixed.

critical.issue: Integrity guard is applied only to the initial verify report. If the guard downgrades a .md skip row, then self-heal returns no replacement/escalates, subset reverify calls verify_files again and overwrites the row back to ok:true/linter:skip while the submitted file still contains the elision marker. This reopens the `.md skip == pass` part of the incident, though the pre-ship guard later blocks commit.

rca_of_the_issue: The implemented verify guard mutates the initial verify report, but the self-heal loop later replaces failing rows with subset_report results from verify_files and recomputes ok from linter results only. For .md files, verify_files returns skip/ok:true without inspecting content, so a no-op/escalated healer can convert an integrity failure back to ok:true while placeholder content remains. Pre-ship defense-in-depth still blocks the commit, but the verify-skip contract remains broken.
